name: RefCOCOg
description: A referring-expression comprehension dataset built from COCO images, containing natural-language expressions referring to objects and corresponding object annotations. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Mao, J., Huang, J., Toshev, A., Camburu, O., Yuille, A. L., & Murphy, K. (2016). Generation and Comprehension of Contextualized Referring Expressions. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 4171–4180. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2016.452

license.identifier: Custom dataset terms; no standard SPDX identifier
license.notes: RefCOCOg is distributed under dataset-specific terms rather than a standard SPDX license identifier. Images originate from COCO and retain their applicable image rights; review the upstream terms and source-image licenses before use or redistribution.
